comments: For the signature number, only "7" is visible on the image in the <<bKa' gdams gsung 'bum [Z5AUD7GQ]>> reproduction. The editors also report the signature as "phyi tsa 7" (<<bKa' gdams gsung 'bum dkar chag [S635TW6P]>>: 65). However, in view of the title, authorship and number of folios, it appears to correspond with item no. 15516 with signature "phyi tsa 57" in the <<'Bras spungs dkar chag [8H6M69W4]>>.
